text:
That jealousy eating you isn't the problem. What you do with it is.

You see a man with something you want. It burns. That feeling is real.

It's data. Your body is telling you what matters. Most men get stuck there. They hate the guy. They make excuses.

Smart men redirect. He's building something. You can too. Start moving toward it.

Your brain doesn't know real from imagined. Feed it one story over and over, that becomes your reality.

Next time you feel that jealousy: read the signal. Then take one real action.

Jealousy is a map. Use it.
caption:
Every emotion is data about what you want.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
